course_lessons.TITLE: Principles & Legal Framework of Public Procurement
course_lessons.DESCRIPTION: Public procurement at the federal level is governed by the Public Procurement Act 2007, which established the Bureau of Public Procurement (BPP). This lesson introduces the core principles of value for money, competition, transparency, accountability and fairness.

course_lessons.TITLE: Procurement Methods & Approvals
course_lessons.DESCRIPTION: Open competitive bidding is the default method for public procurement. Other methods, such as selective tendering, request for quotations and direct procurement, are allowed only in justified circumstances. This lesson explains when each method applies and how approval thresholds and the Certificate of No Objection work.

course_lessons.TITLE: Contract Management & Record Keeping
course_lessons.DESCRIPTION: Procurement does not end at contract award. This lesson covers monitoring delivery, handling contract variations, certifying completion, and keeping a complete procurement file as an audit trail.
